title: ATL-osteolytic-transcriptomics: Single-cell and bulk transcriptomic dissection of osteolytic programs in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
description:
This repository contains the analysis code, gene panels, example results, and documentation accompanying the manuscript Single-cell and bulk transcriptomic dissection of osteolytic programs in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma reveals tumour-T-cell-intrinsic and Treg-like contributions to bone destruction, supported by serum bone turnover phenotypes in a Chinese cohort by Weng et al. (Frontiers in Immunology, 2026).

Includes: (i) Module A scRNA-seq cell-of-origin analysis of GSE195674 with Seurat v5; (ii) Module B BayesPrism bulk deconvolution of GSE33615 + GSE55851 with MuSiC cross-method validation; (iii) Module C DESeq2 differential expression for ATL+/− T-cell lines from CCLE Public 24Q4 with ProfileID-to-ModelID validation against DepMap OmicsProfiles; (iv) Module D Connectivity Map / LINCS triple-tool reverser screening (clue.io, Enrichr LINCS, L1000CDS²) yielding 41 ATL-relevant convergent candidates spanning four mechanistic themes; (v) clinical descriptive and survival analysis of a 29-patient Chinese ATL cohort with comprehensive serum bone turnover profiling.
